capabilities: Zoom images with the mouse wheel or control buttons
Drag and pan images with the mouse or arrow keys
View images in integrated or popup modes
Support SVG and IMG images including Mermaid, PlantUML, and Graphviz diagrams
extras: Full documentation is kept in a separate DOCS.md file rather than in the README.
problem: Images and diagrams embedded in notes are static, making it hard to inspect details in large or dense diagrams.
summary: Interactive image viewer that adds zoom, drag, fullscreen, and control panels to images and diagrams in notes.
